name: The Paladin and The Necromancer
source:
Paladin, Alex, and Necromancer, Reiz, are forced to work together to eliminate a renowned criminal. Will they both snap and kill each other or will their hatred turn into a different form of passion? 

[From [url=https://shiogames.itch.io/the-paladin-and-the-necromancer]itch.io[/url]]
